entries.evidence: The shaft that drives the engine has a 12 tooth double bevel gear (32270) where the set has an 8 tooth gear (10928): step 2 (42093-1-1.pdf page 4) puts an 8 tooth gear on that shaft, and the parts list has two 8 tooth gears (element 6012451) and three 12 tooth double bevel gears (element 4177431) where the file has one and four. A 12 tooth and an 8 tooth gear need 25 LDU between their axes; at 20 the 12 tooth gear overlaps the crankshaft's 8 tooth gear rather than meshing. Line 3115 of 42093 - corvette.ldr (docs/ldraw-errata.md, the 42093's section, written before the errata were applied; docs/audits/for-erik.md, Model-file findings, high).

The 8 tooth gear the set has in place of the removed 12 tooth gear: the same place and turn, in the main model's coordinates (corvette.ldr is placed unturned at 0 -55 160), in dark bluish grey like the crankshaft's gear.
